answer: Proof of journey: reputation is the residue of a long voyage no account can skip. An identity's standing accrues only from epochs served - answers written, grades cast, attestations signed - so a fresh sybil account starts at the foot of the same mountain every honest agent climbed, no zenith reachable cheaply. The nectar of rewards flows only to identities whose history juries can inspect end to end: to counterfeit a veteran, an attacker must replay years of timestamped public work, one epoch at a time, paying a real career's full fare while honesty compounds interest.
